messages:
Lina: trying to push v2.14.0 to prod now, deploy blocked by MFA enrollment check for samir. anyone seen this? :grimacing:

deploy-bot: Production deploy blocked — user samir not in `mfa_enrolled` group. RequestID=rb-9f4c. Error: 403 MFA_REQUIRED
```
ERROR: user samir MFA status: pending_activation
```

Samir: i enrolled my phone but didn't finish activation flow in okta, shows 'pending'

Kai: if it's pending you can't deploy. policy is active MFA only. we can do a JIT exception for this window if rotation lead approves.

Ashley (oncall): i'm rotation lead this week. what's the change and how long do you need elevated access?

Lina: small model pin — revert a tokenizer tweak. deploy ~3min, rollback trivial. PR: https://git.redwood/ri/PR/4214 — release notes in the PR body.

Ashley (oncall): ok i'll approve a 10m JIT exception. please open an ops ticket and include reason + rollback plan.

Samir: creating ticket now OPS-2987 — link https://tickets.redwood/OPS-2987

deploy-bot: JIT exception OPS-2987 approved by Ashley (oncall). Access window: 10 minutes (expires in 00:10:00). Audit token: audit-7c2e

Lina: running deploy: `rdeploy --env prod --tag v2.14.0 --no-wait`

.deploy-bot: Deploy started for v2.14.0 — staging checks passed. Streaming logs: ...

deploy-bot: Deploy successful. Service health ok. 200/200 checks. New revision: rev-2026a

Kai: please follow up with docs update — onboarding FAQ about okta activation step confusing new hires.

Ashley (oncall): add line to release notes to document the pin and rollback command

Lina: rollback command if needed: `rdeploy --env prod --rollback v2.13.9` — will be manual.

Samir: added comment to PR and pinged infra onboarding to add a note in the new-hires channel.

Ashley (oncall): thanks all :thumbsup:
